dtc_applicability.ecu: PCM or TCM; retrieve source module
dtc_applicability.source_statement: One or more of the TSB listed DTCs, with harsh/delayed engagement or shift, on a listed 10R80 vehicle; NOT assertion every individual VIN has this fault
dtc_applicability.applicability_condition: Ford WSM + PTS/OASIS must confirm VIN and TSB date/software eligibility
diagnostic_steps: Confirm vehicle model, non-hybrid 10R80, and actual production date on/before 15-Aug-2022.
Read PCM and TCM separately using Ford FDRS/IDS; record freeze-frame and all companion DTCs before clearing.
Follow current Ford OASIS/WSM procedure to test for CDF hydraulic circuit leakage; TSB identifies CDF cylinder sleeve axial movement as a possible cause, not a certainty.
Use approved Ford/Rotunda diagnostic instruments; if the criteria and hydraulic test confirm leakage, follow TSB component repair and fluid inspection.
Verify correct adaptive learning, recheck DTCs, and road-test. Do not replace 10R80 parts based solely on the code.
tools: FDRS/IDS capable scan system
VCMM 164-R9534 Transmission Extension Kit when Ford test calls for it
Pressure Vacuum Transducer Kit Rotunda 164-R9833 when available and bulletin procedure requires
